summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting to signed-in account  ### What I did (read-only) I traced the full path end-to-end before proposing anything: `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite schema, plus `useAuth.tsx`/`App.tsx` (route gating) and the session-cookie config in `modules/auth/handlers.ts`.  ### What's actually fine (so we don't re-litigate it) - Watchlist routes correctly scope every query by `user_id` (`eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`), including add/remove/create/delete — no
